items.design: MILITARY.md § Missiles and § Space. items.title: A price falls as its supply vanishes, with demand flat
items.design: MARKETS.md § Price resolution: target = base x sqrt(demand / supply), and base x ceil_mult with no supply, so a price should climb as supply falls toward zero. Read on seed 31 at the blockaded market 47921 (naval_reading, 40 ticks, 2026-11-10): machinery supply 1.7 -> 0.1 a tick, demand 7.5 flat (all background), yet the price fell 473.43 -> 370.00 while other markets moved x0.969. A price of 473 standing above what looks like the band ceiling (370) means a price is written outside resolve_price, or the ceiling moved. Find which, and whether it is a defect or a rule the doc does not state. Read before changing anything. Carried at the sprint 64 close (2026-11-10): an investigation, not started; read before changing anything.
